voiceArbitration.note: POKEY voice 1 is CONTENDED FOUR WAYS, and the ROM's own SOUNDS header says so: CENTI4.MAC:2326 reads 'CHAN 1=BONUS, CENTIPEDE, ANT AND SCORPION SOUNDS', which is the POKEY VOICE and not the CHAN1 variable (CENDE4.MAC:194 declares that variable as the centipede index alone). The ROM writes AUDF1 in exactly four places, one per cue — the bonus life (CENTI4.MAC:2382), the scorpion loop (CENTI4.MAC:2392), the computed ant/flea voice (CENTI4.MAC:2414) and the march (CENTI4.MAC:2433) — and all four converge on a single AUDC1 write (CENTI4.MAC:2435), so at most one of them sounds at a time. THE PRIORITY IS DECIDED BEFORE THE ARBITRATION BLOCK, AND THE BONUS WINS BY NOT BRANCHING: CENTI4.MAC:2374 is BEQ 48$, so a ZERO CHAN4 goes TO 48$ and the arbitration runs. While a bonus tone is live CHAN4 is non-zero, the branch is not taken, and the bonus block runs instead — on the eighth frame it takes the AUDF1 write itself, on the other seven it leaves for the player-explosion tail (CENTI4.MAC:2377), and either way 48$ is skipped. One frame is the exception: on the tick the countdown expires, CENTI4.MAC:2379-2380 (DEY / BEQ 48$) drops into the arbitration as the tone ends. With no bonus sounding, the march block (CENTI4.MAC:2428) is entered ONLY when the ant/scorpion is off screen (CENTI4.MAC:2399), the player is exploding or dead (CENTI4.MAC:2402), or the ant/scorpion is exploding (CENTI4.MAC:2406). Full order: bonus > scorpion > flea > march. The scorpion and the flea share creature slot 12, so they cannot both be live. NOTE FOR cp6-2: CENTI4.MAC:2382 is label 44$, which the declined 15-second TIMED-play alarm also jumps to (CENTI4.MAC:2369, CENTI4.MAC:2371) — a fifth claimant, out of scope, and it would enter ABOVE the bonus because its own test runs first.
voiceArbitration.ourShellDiffers: Our CHANNELS map (src/shell/audio.ts) gives all four contenders their own channel — bonusLife on 'chan4', march on 'voice-march', fleaLoop on 'voice-flea', scorpionLoop on 'voice-scorpion' — so all four can ring together where the cabinet allows exactly one. That is a cp5-1 decision, made before this ruling existed. The clone will therefore sound FULLER than the cabinet whenever a flea, scorpion or bonus is live during a wave. This story does not change it (AC-5 forbids editing the map); it records the divergence so it is a decision rather than a surprise. spiderLoop is NOT part of this: it writes AUDF3 (CENTI4.MAC:2349), owns POKEY voice 3 outright and rings alongside voice 1 on the cabinet too, so its separate channel is faithful rather than a departure.

derivation: lengthSeconds = lengthFrames * frameGate / FRAME_HZ. lengthFrames is the ROM's own countdown seed, decoded in the radix the ROM spells (bare literals are hex under .RADIX 16 inherited from CENDE4; only a trailing period is decimal). frameGate is the number of VIDEO frames per SOUNDS pass for that cue, which is 1 unless the routine masks FRAME first. SOUNDS is called once per video frame from MAIN (CENTI4.MAC:24) after the loop waits on SYNC, so a pass IS a frame. FRAME_HZ is imported from src/shell/timebase.ts and is deliberately not restated here.

fire.note: The SHOT SOUND. FREQ2 has no CONT2 companion: the control byte is the immediate hex 64 at CENTI4.MAC:2358, written to AUDC2 at :2359. Ungated — CHAN2 steps once per SOUNDS pass.

mushroom.note: NO ROM SOURCE. The shot-hits-mushroom path scores the mushroom, rewrites the playfield stamp and jumps to 20$ (CENTI4.MAC:2169) — which is the line AFTER the 19$ explosion seed at :2299-2300. The mushroom path steps over the sound that a creature kill raises, so this is a deliberate silence in the machine and not an omission. OBSTAC, which our manifest names for this cue (CENTI4.MAC:1701-1739), is a pure playfield-address lookup with no sound register write anywhere in it.
mushroom.cp62Decision: cp6-2 must decide: bake a declared stand-in and LABEL it an invention, or leave the cue silent and let the manifest entry resolve to nothing. It must not be baked as if transcribed. Recommendation: a declared stand-in, because a shot that visibly bites a mushroom with no feedback reads as a bug to a modern player — but the label is not optional.

segmentKill.note: Collapses onto CHAN0's single EXPLOSION SOUND table. Every creature kill converges on label 19$ (CENTI4.MAC:2299-2300): the segment path arrives by JMP 19$ at :2289, the spider, ant and scorpion paths by falling through 18$ at :2296. Four of our cue names, one ROM sound. That is the machine's behaviour, not a compromise — and it is what the CHANNELS map already models by putting all four kills on one voice-stealing bucket.

headBottom.note: NO ROM SOURCE. A head reaching the bottom row sets NEWD to arm the new-head factory (CENTI4.MAC:1310) and does nothing else; there is no CHANn write anywhere on that path. The event is real and important to play, but the machine marks it visually, not audibly.
headBottom.cp62Decision: cp6-2 must decide: bake a declared stand-in or leave silent. Recommendation: leave silent. Unlike the mushroom, this moment already announces itself — the screen fills with new heads — so an invented cue here adds a sound the arcade player never heard for no compensating clarity.

playerDeath.note: The general explosion made LOUDER, not a sound of its own. CHAN5 replays FREQ0/CONT0 (CENTI4.MAC:2444) and adds hex 02 to the control byte to INCREASE VOLUME (:2449). That is why the table numbering skips FREQ5. Player death also zeroes CHAN0, CHAN1, CHAN2, CHAN3 and CHAN6 (:1813-1818) so the explosion plays alone.

waveClear.note: NO ROM SOURCE for the wave transition itself: clearing a wave sets DELAY (CENTI4.MAC:2319) with no CHANn write. But the between-wave RESTOR sweep IS audible — it seeds CHAN0 with the explosion cue once per restored mushroom (CENTI4.MAC:1881-1882). So the wave end is silent and the wave cleanup is a burst of explosions; there is no jingle anywhere.
waveClear.cp62Decision: cp6-2 must decide, and this one is not a simple stand-in. Option A: leave silent and accept that our shell has no cue for the RESTOR burst either. Option B: bake this cue as the explosion sample and have the shell fire it per restored mushroom, which is what the machine does — but that is a WIRING change in core/shell, out of scope for a baker story. Recommendation: A for cp6-2, and file B as its own story.

bonusLife.note: The BONUS LIFE SOUND, raised where the extra life is awarded (CENTI4.MAC:1993-1995). FREQ4 is the only table spanning two lines (decimal 8 bytes then decimal 9), and its decimal 17 seed is the radix trap in this engine: read hex, the seed is decimal 23 and runs six entries past the table.

march.note: The SOUND OF LITTLE FEET, and it is the LAST of the four claimants on POKEY voice 1: the march block at CENTI4.MAC:2428 is reached only when the ant/scorpion is off screen (:2399), the player is exploding (:2402), or the ant/scorpion is exploding (:2406) — and a live bonus tone skips that arbitration entirely (CENTI4.MAC:2373-2374). A live flea, scorpion or bonus takes the voice instead. CONT1 says MUST BE REPEATED (CENTI4.MAC:2458) and the repeat is mechanical: MOTION re-seeds CHAN1 every decimal 16 frames (CENTI4.MAC:1286-1289) while the cue itself is only decimal 7 passes long. The machine's own words for the test are ;IF NOT 1/4 SECOND BOUNDARY at CENTI4.MAC:1287 — a branch AWAY from the seed, not a label on it. So it rings for 7 frames of every 16 for as long as the centipede is moving — a tick, not a drone.

spiderLoop.note: The spider, and the ONLY cue on the every-other-frame side of the LSR gate (CENTI4.MAC:2338-2340). CONT3 says WELL REPEAT UNTIL TURNED OFF (:2462) and SOUNDS reseeds CHAN3 to hex 14 = decimal 20 in place (:2346-2347). It is turned off explicitly when the spider is shot (:2255) or leaves the screen (:282).

fleaLoop.note: ROM-sourced but COMPUTED, not tabulated, and it rides no countdown variable at all. While the ant (flea) is on screen SOUNDS derives AUDF1 from ANTV — the flea's vertical position — every pass (CENTI4.MAC:2409-2414), forcing the result to hex 80 or above to USE LOWER FREQUENCIES. The pitch therefore falls as the flea descends. It has no length: it lasts exactly as long as the flea is on screen, and it is not a fixed sample.
fleaLoop.cp62Decision: cp6-2 cannot bake this as a fixed sample without losing what it IS. The pitch is a function of the flea's Y position, so a single .wav is a stand-in for a sweep. Bake a descending sweep across the ANTV range and say so, or drive playbackRate from the flea's position at the shell — the latter is faithful but is a wiring change beyond a baker story.

scorpionLoop.note: The scorpion, an explicit CONTINOUS LOOP (the ROM's spelling, CENTI4.MAC:2388) that reseeds CHAN6 to DECIMAL 20 in place (:2389). Ungated — it steps every SOUNDS pass. Turned off when the ant is set up (:155), since flea and scorpion share creature slot 12.
